name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Consolidated 0.0.136-0.0.158: security and access fixes (confused-deputy peer POSTs, signed download flag, item-scoped playback/image capabilities, no re-sharing of downloaded federated files, anonymous inventory hardening, HMAC expiry, bounded friend requests/icons), correctness fixes (mapping/cache-key stability, catalog pruning, pool icons, Downloads path, strm export safety, WAN cap on direct streams, live Kestrel port for stamped paths), Companion/Plex fixes, and settings-page fixes including Friends copy, pool refresh, and per-user BlockedItemIds round-trip.
